mission: Determine whether Commodity can develop a defensible natural-gas forecasting or trading edge.

retrospective_synthesis.purpose: Preserve zoom-in/zoom-out programme memory without rewriting historical experiment authority.
retrospective_synthesis.historical_fact_rule: historical_facts are summaries of cited authoritative evidence; programme_interpretation is the current programme-level reading and may change as new evidence arrives.
retrospective_synthesis.state_rule: Keep rejected_by_evidence, open_untested, and interesting_observation distinct; untested is not promising and a narrow rejection is not a global rejection of an information family.

research_lines.big_picture: Establish an honest leakage-safe baseline before escalating model complexity.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: The programme needed to know whether daily market state, seasonality and PIT exogenous context could beat a simple zero-return control.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Naive/zero, Ridge and HistGB next-session log-return forecasting at a one-session horizon under expanding walk-forward evaluation.

historical_facts.observed: The frozen V1 tournament completed reproducibly and did not establish a robust predictive edge.
historical_facts.rules_out: Promotion of the tested V1 hypothesis/model ladder for this target and contract.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Different targets, horizons, mechanisms, signal roles or later integrated decisions.

useful_secondary_observations: The zero-return baseline is a strong hurdle for later return experiments.
V1 became the common comparison baseline rather than a promoted model.
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Only revisit one-session return forecasting when a bounded mechanism or new information source changes the expected-information-value case.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Move from generic model search toward complementary, mechanism-led signal families and stronger controls.

research_lines.big_picture: Ask whether new model and PIT indicator families add information beyond V1 before attempting fusion.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: V1 failed to establish an edge, so V2 decomposed the problem into Kronos and indicator/surprise components with fusion only after valid component evidence.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Kronos-only and indicator-only next-session return components, with fusion/sensitivity contingent on valid predecessors.

historical_facts.observed: The original Kronos result lineage was superseded after contract/target defects; the indicator path failed closed before fit on frozen weather staleness; fusion and sensitivity never produced empirical results.
historical_facts.rules_out: Treating the original #82 result or unexecuted #84/#85 designs as evidence of an edge.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Corrected same-contract model tests or future bounded uses of the underlying information families.

useful_secondary_observations: Fail-closed data gates prevented rescue search after a frozen input violation.
Fusion must not proceed when component evidence is invalid or absent.
remaining_untested_roles: future PIT indicators under a new justified contract
research_lines.revisit_trigger: A new bounded hypothesis must have valid PIT inputs, same-contract comparators and independent confirmation capacity before execution.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Preserve the negative/untested distinction and repair contract continuity before interpreting model quality.

research_lines.big_picture: Retest Kronos only after fixing target and contract continuity so the result is comparable and auditable.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: The original Kronos lineage could not support a trustworthy model conclusion; a corrected frozen three-checkpoint comparison was required.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Kronos Mini/Small/Base as direct one-step next-session return forecasters on 204 common OOS rows.

historical_facts.observed: Mini RMSE 0.0616096, Small 0.0552931 and Base 0.0664801 were all worse than zero-return 0.0453231 and V1 HistGB 0.0465073; checkpoint size did not improve monotonically.
historical_facts.rules_out: Direct one-step Kronos promotion for the frozen target/grain and post-result size rescue.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Kronos in a materially different bounded role, target, horizon or representation.

useful_secondary_observations: Model scale was not a reliable path to improvement.
Corrected contract identity changed the scientific conclusion from ambiguous to negative.
remaining_untested_roles: different mechanism-specific target where separately justified
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Only a preregistered role with a distinct mechanism, adequate effective information and fresh confirmation can reopen Kronos research.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Retire direct one-step Kronos and change the research question before changing model size.

research_lines.big_picture: Test whether changing the economic/statistical target reveals stronger structure than generic next-session returns.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: Repeated return-model failures made target and mechanism selection more valuable than broader model search.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Realized-volatility/variance diagnostics followed by power-gated volatility and event-specific confirmation designs.

historical_facts.observed: The HAR-style volatility diagnostic improved QLIKE by about 15.55% on 204 diagnostic rows, but protected confirmation was not opened because power gates showed detectable effects materially larger than the declared 5% MEPI.
historical_facts.rules_out: Claiming a confirmed volatility edge from the diagnostic or spending protected confirmation when the design is underpowered.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Volatility or event mechanisms with materially more effective information, stronger effect size, or a different predeclared design.

useful_secondary_observations: Volatility persistence is the strongest positive diagnostic observation so far.
Calendar row count is not equivalent to effective independent information.
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Reopen only when nuisance-only feasibility shows detectable effect at or below the declared MEPI while preserving fresh confirmation.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Keep volatility alive as an observation, not a promoted signal; make power and MEPI a precondition for protected testing.

research_lines.big_picture: Test whether a strong external foundation time-series model adds standalone or complementary return information without widening the search adaptively.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: A bounded zero-shot challenger could test model-family complementarity while preserving the same 204-row comparison contract.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: TimesFM 2.5 zero-shot next-session return representations and exactly 12 preregistered 50/50 blends with V1 HistGB.

historical_facts.observed: Standalone point forecasts did not beat zero-return; some representations were complementary to HistGB, but all 12 bounded blends failed the stronger zero-return joint gate.
historical_facts.rules_out: Promotion of the tested TimesFM return/blend programme and treating the consumed 204 rows as fresh confirmation.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: A new, distinct TimesFM role with its own bounded hypothesis and untouched confirmation path.

useful_secondary_observations: Complementarity against another model is insufficient if the combined system still fails the economic/statistical baseline.
A bounded successor avoided turning an observation into open-ended blend search.
remaining_untested_roles: distinct non-return or representation roles only if programme-value justified
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Require a new mechanism, target or role that could materially change a programme decision plus fresh confirmation capacity.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Do not continue generic TimesFM return/blend search; preserve the complementarity observation without promoting it.

research_lines.big_picture: Reduce research debt to a small set of decision-relevant gaps instead of executing every plausible idea.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: Negative/null model evidence and power constraints made experiment selection itself a scientific control.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Portfolio disposition only; no empirical rerun or new protected result was authorized by this line.

historical_facts.observed: Geographic expansion, professional-consensus sourcing, several event subcomponents and volatility confirmation were deferred/superseded or folded into bounded primary hypotheses; curve/spread remained a future direction.
historical_facts.rules_out: Treating every open hypothesis as an executable obligation.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Deferred mechanisms when a concrete programme gap, PIT/source case and feasibility gate later justify them.

useful_secondary_observations: Untested possibilities are not evidence of promise.
A future experiment should exist only when its result could change a programme decision.
remaining_untested_roles: selected fundamentals or geographic sources only after a concrete gap is established
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Promote a deferred idea only when it addresses a current programme gap and clears expected-information-value, PIT/source, MEPI, power and confirmation-capacity gates.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Keep the next research branch small, mechanism-led and decision-relevant; speculative possibilities remain observations rather than backlog debt.

research_lines.big_picture: Make future research claims machine-checkable and preserve programme memory so the project does not repeatedly rediscover why controls matter.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: Historical defects exposed weaknesses in freeze discipline, evidence ownership, leakage verification, programme inference and experiment-memory continuity.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Methodology/control infrastructure rather than an empirical market hypothesis.

historical_facts.observed: The repository now enforces immutable preregistration, separate result/interpretation/record authority, programme inference, sealed-window accounting, evidence classes, reproducibility controls and generated executive summaries; no real post-hardening confirmatory record exists yet.
historical_facts.rules_out: Treating prose discipline or remembered context as sufficient evidence control.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Implementation defects that may emerge during the first real governed commissioning run.

useful_secondary_observations: Legacy V1/V2 evidence must remain byte/identity stable rather than being retrospectively converted.
The first real future confirmatory experiment is also the live commissioning test of the hardened lifecycle.
remaining_untested_roles: first real post-hardening confirmatory record/projection lifecycle
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Audit the lifecycle after the first real governed confirmatory experiment or whenever a control fails closed unexpectedly.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: Use the hardened lifecycle for all future confirmatory work while keeping research evidence separate from trading authority.

research_lines.big_picture: Find the smallest next experiment that can materially change the programme's belief about a tradable information mechanism.
research_lines.why_zoomed_in: Generic one-session return model search has repeatedly failed, while the strongest positive observation remains unconfirmed because effective information was inadequate.
research_lines.tested_role_target_horizon: Not yet selected; target, horizon and information family must be justified before preregistration.

historical_facts.observed: No robust trading edge is established.
historical_facts.rules_out: Broad adaptive model search as the default next branch.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Mechanism-led curve/spread, event, volatility or other complementary signal roles that clear feasibility before protected testing.

useful_secondary_observations: The integrated system still needs complementary signal families whose value survives simple baselines and realistic evidence gates.
remaining_untested_roles: other complementary non-model information roles after programme-value screening
research_lines.revisit_trigger: Refresh this selection when a candidate has quantified MEPI, dependence/effective information, source/PIT fitness and untouched confirmation capacity.
research_lines.programme_interpretation: The highest-value next branch is the first bounded mechanism-led candidate that is feasible enough to answer a real programme decision, not the newest model.

stopping_rules.negative_evidence: stop or branch when repeated governed evidence rejects the mechanism
stopping_rules.feasible_power: hold until the selected slice has a quantitative feasibility calculation
stopping_rules.economic_relevance: stop if the economic MEPI cannot be cleared
stopping_rules.confirmation_capacity: hold if no independent confirmation capacity remains
stopping_rules.expected_information_value: choose the next slice only when it can materially change a programme decision

known: No robust reproducible trading edge has been established.
Generic next-session return forecasting has repeatedly failed strong simple baselines under corrected contracts.
Research controls now prevent invalid data, underpowered confirmation and post-result rescue from being mistaken for evidence.
repeatedly_failed: TimesFM return/blend promotion against the zero-return hurdle
mechanisms_still_alive: volatility persistence as an unconfirmed diagnostic observation
other complementary signal roles only after programme-value screening
missing_not_negative: first real post-hardening confirmatory lifecycle commissioning
integrated_system_needs: complementary signal families with incremental information
realistic execution and forward validation after research promotion
current_helicopter_view.next_branch_reason: The next experiment should maximize expected information value by testing one plausible mechanism with enough effective information to clear a declared MEPI while preserving fresh confirmation capacity.

feasibility_map.hold_reason: No confirmatory slice is authorised until target-specific MEPI, dependence and effective information are quantified.

semantics.selection_rule: Choose confirmatory slices for expected information value, not technical novelty.
semantics.legacy_evidence_rule: Retrospective programme synthesis may summarize historical authority but must not modify or replace legacy experiment evidence identity.
semantics.follow_up_rule: Create actionable follow-up only when it addresses a current programme gap and could materially change a programme decision.
